description: Per-category recommended fusion configuration based on leave-one-out cross-validation. Training on 5 categories, testing on the held-out 6th.

bracket_black.note: LoO selects two_stage, but weighted_ensemble dino=0.60 gives much higher in-distribution ΔAP (+0.214). Consider manual override.

bracket_brown.note: Very low AP baseline (~0.046). All fusion gains are marginal. Consider this category as edge case.

bracket_white.note: Stable gains. dino=0.60 generalizes better (LoO pick); dino=0.75 slightly higher in-distribution.

connector.note: Strong gains (~+0.09 ΔAP). Both dino=0.60 and dino=0.70 perform well.

metal_plate.note: ONLY negative LoO category. DINO baseline AP=0.847 is already very high. two_stage alpha=0.60 shows in-distribution gain (+0.088) but LoO fails to generalize. Manual tuning recommended.

tubes.note: Largest gains across all categories. DINO baseline AP=0.572. weighted_ensemble generalizes well; two_stage gives even higher in-distribution gain.

global_recommendation.rationale: This single configuration was selected by LoO for 4/6 categories and achieves mean ΔAP=+0.046 in held-out evaluation. It is the most robust and generalizable fusion configuration.
